subject.summary: Le Corbusier and Pierre Jeanneret, Poissy, 1928–1931. Plan-led reconstruction of the floating prism, automobile-shaped entrance, architectural promenade and roof solarium.

how: The central ramp links the curved entrance to the living terrace and roof solarium.
The large court beside the ramp is open to the sky.
Published overall dimensions anchor the model; intermediate levels and construction thicknesses are estimated.
Plan outlines are hand-traced. Photographs depict the restored building, not a survey of 1931 fabric.
Plant silhouettes are inferred from restored-building photographs, not authenticated 1931 planting.

authoring.provenance_note: Published dimensions and structural module are cited. Plan outlines are hand-traced; levels, thicknesses, joinery and hidden structure are inferred. Photos show the restored villa. This post-masterpiece solid-fit repair is self-reviewed; the round-12 critic judged the preserved pre-repair scene.
next: Refine historically documented joinery, planting and salon furnishings from additional scaled drawings.
